messages.author: ac19819864ba3828
messages.subject: "Histogram ~ ScatterPlot Combo"
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to reproduce the attached plot "Histogram ~ ScatterPlot Combo" using ggplot and gridExtra.


My attempt is as follows:

# Generate Data ----
n=100
v.crewCount = factor(sample(x=c(2,5,7,10,12,15,18),n,rep=T))
v.roomsClean = sample(x=seq(1,80),n,rep=T)
df.1 = data.frame(crew=v.crewCount, rooms=v.roomsClean)
v.label = seq(0,80,len=5)
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

# Plots ----
p1 = ggplot(df.1) + geom_point(aes(x=crew,y=rooms),color="darkgreen",jitter=1)+theme_bw()
p2 = ggplot(df.1,aes(crew)) + geom_bar(fill="white",color="darkgreen")+theme_bw()
p3 = ggplot(df.1,aes(x=rooms)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=5,  fill="white",color="darkgreen") + theme_bw() + coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0,20,40,60,80),labels=c(0,20,40,60,80))
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~


# arranging the plots ----
library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(p3,p1,p2,nrow=2)
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~


The problems are as follows:

1. For p3, I am unable to change the axis labels despite trying:
scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0,20,40,60,80),labels=c(0,20,40,60,80))

2. In terms of arranging, I want to push p2 into second row, but could not find any options in following:
grid.arrange(p3,p1,p2,nrow=2)

 The output of my attempt is attached as "Attempt1.pdf"


Cheers !

messages.author: ac19819864ba3828
messages.subject: Re: "Histogram ~ ScatterPlot Combo"
parts:
Hi,

I was able to resolve the #1 issue as follows:

p3 = ggplot(df.1,aes(x=rooms)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=5,  fill="white",color="darkgreen") + theme_bw() + coord_flip() + scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,80))


Cheers !

messages.subject: Re: "Histogram ~ ScatterPlot Combo"
parts:
Hi,

grid.arrange() is not suitable for these layouts where you want the axes to be rigorously aligned. A better starting point would be to use gtable like in these two examples,

http://stackoverflow.com/a/17371177/471093
http://stackoverflow.com/a/17493256/471093

HTH,

b.
